name: Desert Ruin World
description: A dry desert world with Ancient ruins scattered near the gate. The Destiny's second gate dial landed the away team here.

objectives.label: Find resources
objectives.description: Scan the area for mineral deposits and water sources the Destiny needs.

objectives.label: Investigate Ancient ruins
objectives.description: Ancient ruins were detected near the gate. Investigate them for any useful technology.

objectives.label: Retrieve Ancient technology
objectives.description: Recover any Ancient device found in the ruins. Rush will want to study it.
